data.description:
## Context / Problem

`rebar store fsck --help` documents `--only ONLY` as "check only the named ticket(s)" (`src/rebar/_cli/_parsers/core/repair.py:49`), but `fsck_cli` (`src/rebar/_commands/fsck.py:332-348`) accepts exactly one value, `--only=stale-channel`, and only together with `--repair`. Observed 2026-11-04 at e0bfa4e5154:

- `rebar store fsck --repair-snapshots --dry-run --only 77b6-868f-f4bd-461f` -> `Error: --only requires a value` (the space-separated form documented by argparse is rejected outright).
- `... --only=77b6-868f-f4bd-461f` -> `Error: unknown --only value '77b6-868f-f4bd-461f'`.

An operator following the help text to scope a snapshot repair to one ticket (respirable-trapezial-ekaltadeta) cannot, and has to run the whole-store pass instead.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `rebar store fsck --help` describes `--only` as what the command actually accepts, or the command accepts what the help describes; a test pins help text and parser behaviour together.
- [ ] `--only <value>` (space-separated) and `--only=<value>` behave the same.
data.title: store fsck --help says --only takes ticket ids; the command accepts only --only=stale-channel
